crossRefs.note: When God heard this, he was angry, and greatly abhorred Israel,
Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of raiders who plundered them. He sold them…
Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel; and he said, “Because this nation transgressed my covenant which I commanded…
Therefore Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Cushan Rishathaim king of…
Therefore you delivered them into the hand of their adversaries, who distressed them. In the time of their trouble…
You shall not walk in the customs of the nation which I am casting out before you; for they did all these things, and…
Yahweh saw and abhorred, because of the provocation of his sons and his daughters.
I cut off the three shepherds in one month; for my soul was weary of them, and their soul also loathed me.
God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?
Yet they are your people and your inheritance, which you brought out by your great power and by your outstretched arm.”

translations.web: Therefore Yahweh burned with anger against his people. He abhorred his inheritance.
translations.bsb: So the anger of the LORD burned against His people, and He abhorred His own inheritance.
translations.kjv: Therefore was the wrath of the LORD kindled against his people, insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance.
translations.asv: Therefore was the wrath of Jehovah kindled against his people, And he abhorred his inheritance.
